note: Authoritative inventory of every environment variable the code reads. Values live in Doppler (logloads project) and Vercel; never commit real values. `status` reflects repo truth and must be provider-verified before cutover.

partial_revision.warning: `generated` is deliberately NOT bumped. Only the cloudinary entries were re-verified on this date; every other `status` string still dates from 2026-07-22 and several are stale in the DANGEROUS direction — they read MISSING for variables production must already have (LOGLOADS_SESSION_SECRET is documented MISSING while its own absent_behavior says the app THROWS at startup in production, and production is live, so it cannot actually be missing). Treat an unrevised `status` as a claim needing provider confirmation, never as evidence a variable is absent or a feature is inactive.

denied_cloudinary_cloud_names.rule: Checked FIRST, before the tenancy marker and before the credentials, against BOTH CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME and LOGLOADS_CLOUDINARY_EXPECTED_CLOUD, case- and whitespace-insensitively. Cannot be overridden by any other variable, including a `dedicated` tenancy marker or an expected name set to the same denied value.
denied_cloudinary_cloud_names.why: Driver credential documents are a person's licence and insurance papers. The failure mode is not media breaking; it is media WORKING, reporting success throughout, while writing those documents into another product's Cloudinary account.

names.evidence: 2026-07-17 asset census: 1020 of 1020 stored assets were Explore & Earn's. Present in apps/web/.env.local today under a comment calling it 'sandbox creds'.

variables.name: LOGLOADS_CLOUDINARY_EXPECTED_CLOUD
variables.purpose: The cloud name LogLoads expects to write to, declared independently of the credential block. CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME must equal it exactly (after trimming) or media stays off, so one mispasted credential block cannot activate media by itself. Deliberately NOT prefixed CLOUDINARY_ — that prefix is reserved for values the provider SDK may read, and using it would make the ambient-configuration scan treat this safety check as contamination.
variables.status: MUST remain unset until a dedicated LogLoads Cloudinary account exists. Absence keeps media OFF; it is never read as permission to trust whatever cloud is configured.
variables.absent_behavior: integrations.media=false; refusal reason expected_cloud_absent
